top.name: Conduit Web
top.rules_text: Weave Mirror links chaining the enemies in the area: when one is struck, its partners suffer half as backlash. Enemies crossing a strand take 3 damage.

bottom.name: Clockwork Familiar
bottom.rules_text: Deploy a Familiar on an empty tile beside you (12 HP, 3 DMG, 2 SPD). Once per turn it echoes a spell you cast, while it lives.
